seoTitle: Character Counter - Check Text Length & Limits
metaDescription: Free online Character Counter. Instantly check your character count for Twitter, SEO meta tags, and SMS messages. Tracks characters with and without spaces.
intro: Hitting frustrating text limits on social media or database forms? Our free Character Counter provides real-time tracking of letters, numbers, symbols, and spaces.
whatIs: The Character Counter is a specialized text utility focused specifically on string length. It calculates the exact number of characters in a block of text, highlighting spaces, punctuation, and line breaks.
howToUse: Paste your text into the main text area.
The tool instantly outputs the total character count.
Review the separate metric for 'Characters without spaces' if needed.
howItWorks: The tool uses a simple JavaScript property (`string.length`) to count every single keystroke in the input field. To calculate 'without spaces', it removes all space characters using Regex before counting the remaining length.
workedExample: If you input 'A B C': The total character count is 5 (3 letters + 2 spaces). The character count without spaces is 3.
resultInterpretation: The number tells you exactly how much data space your text takes up, allowing you to edit it down to fit strict database or publishing limits.
useCases: Social Media: Crafting the perfect tweet under 280 characters.
Web Development: Ensuring an SMS notification message stays under the strict 160-character limit to avoid double billing.
SEO: Keeping website title tags under 60 characters so they don't get truncated in Google search results.
tipsAndLimitations: Line breaks (hitting 'Enter' or 'Return') count as characters. In some systems, they count as two characters (CR+LF).
Emojis can sometimes count as multiple characters (up to 4 or more) because of how they are constructed using Unicode combinations.

faq.question: Do spaces count as characters?
faq.answer: Yes. In computing, a space is a valid character (ASCII code 32). However, because many academic assignments exclude spaces, our tool provides both metrics.

faq.question: Why does my emoji count as two characters?
faq.answer: Many modern emojis are built using multiple Unicode code points. A flag emoji, for example, is actually two regional indicator letters merged together, which the computer counts as two characters.

disclaimer: Tool processes text locally. Extra-complex Unicode emojis may register as multiple characters due to standard JavaScript string length behaviors.
